description: Create (or fetch) the campaign's public view-in-browser link. The hosted page renders an anonymized copy - sample contact, inert unsubscribe link, no open/click tracking - so the URL is safe to forward to anyone, unlike a recipient's personal browser copy. Idempotent: if a link is already active, the same URL is returned with created=false rather than rotating it, so previously shared copies keep working. get_campaign reports the current link as shareUrl (null when none). Revoke with unshare_campaign. Email campaigns only - SMS campaigns have no browser view.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: share_campaign

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `share_campaign` MCP tool.

created.description: False when an already-active link was returned instead of minted.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

shareToken.description: Capability token embedded in the URL.

shareUrl.description: Public anonymized view-in-browser URL for the campaign.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
